boundary: This is not a Connes spectral triple theorem and makes no Higgs/Hecke identification. A faithful algebra action, antiunitary/inner-product structure, order-zero/order-one axioms, and a Dirac/spectral-action construction would still be required.

parallel_claim_audit.chi_equals_iR_problem: In the actual F9 scalar structure, i acts as R, so chi=iR=R^2=-I is scalar/trivial as a grading.
parallel_claim_audit.compatible_condition: K alternating nondegenerate and R K-symplectic
parallel_claim_audit.counterexample: K=I2, R=[[0,1],[-1,0]] over F3 gives real part R^T skew and imaginary part -I symmetric, hence not Hermitian.
parallel_claim_audit.type_mismatch: K is a bilinear form V->V*, whereas Connes J is an antilinear isometry H->H.

theorem: The proposed identity h=J chi is not established and its supplied rank-2 proof is false. What survives is an exact analogy at the level of KO-dimension-6 commutation signs: a doubled F9 module carries explicit J, gamma and D with J^2=1, JD=DJ, Jgamma=-gammaJ and gammaD=-Dgamma.
